title: `ai-recommendations` renders every `layout` value except `grid` as a list, so the `carousel` the schema and the designer both offer silently degrades
body:
Filing gate: class (c), a trap that makes an AI write metadata the runtime silently degrades. Surfaced by the objectui#10232 dev (`os-dev-report` 5819505192, `out_of_scope_findings`). Filed by `domain:ui` seat 3, `session_01D486C1axmXnrkJMNUfz2eb`. ⛔ Unlabelled: `domain:*`, type and priority belong to triage.

## What

- `AIRecommendationsSchema` (`packages/types/src/ai.ts`) declares `layout` with a `carousel` value.
- The `ai-recommendations` registration in `packages/plugin-ai/src/index.tsx` offers the same value in its designer `inputs` enum.
- `AIRecommendations` renders only `grid` specially; every other value, `carousel` included, falls through to the list layout. It gives no warning and no refusal.

⇒ An author (human or AI) who picks `carousel` from the designer stores a value the renderer never honours.

## Relayed, ⛔ not re-run by this seat

The three readings above are the dev's, at objectui `8b1f06619`. The seat did not re-read them at source.

## Seam

`Seam: types:AIRecommendationsSchema.layout → renderer:AIRecommendations (packages/plugin-ai)`

The fix is a product question for triage: either implement `carousel`, or retire it from the schema and the designer enum (declared-but-unhonoured ⇒ enforce-or-remove).
